Trace, implement and test: leetcode130 surrounded regions dfs1

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<iostream>
#include<vector>
#include<queue>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
    int n, m;
    int dx[4] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    int dy[4] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
public:
    void solve(vector<vector<char>>& M) {
        n = M.size();
        m = M[0].size();
        if (m == 0 || n == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
            {
                if (i == 0 || j == 0 || i == n - 1 || j == m - 1) /* 只对边界4条边上值是大写'o'的格子进行dfs */
                {
                    if (M[i][j] == 'O') dfs(M, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
            {
                if (M[i][j] == 'O') M[i][j] = 'X'; /* 留下来的大写'o'的格子是非边界上(内部)的大'o', 且不与边界的大'o'相连, 最终必然会变成X */
                else if (M[i][j] == '$')
                    M[i][j] = 'O';              
            }
        }        
    }
    /* dfs: 把(边界4条边上)所有值是大写'o'的格子标记为$, 并dfs遍历其上下左右4个邻居 */
    void dfs(vector<vector<char>>& M, int x, int y)
    {
        if (M[x][y] != 'O') return;
        M[x][y] = '$';
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        {
            int a = x + dx[i];
            int b = y + dy[i];
            if (a < 0 || a >= n || b < 0 || b >= m || M[a][b] != 'O') continue;
            dfs(M, a, b);
        }  
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<vector<char>> M {
        {'X', 'X', 'X', 'X'},        
        {'X', 'O', 'O', 'X'},        
        {'X', 'X', 'O', 'X'},        
        {'X', 'O', 'X', 'X'}};

    sol.solve(M);
    for (auto& row : M) // 遍历每一行
    {
        for (auto& elem : row) // 输出每一个元素
            cout << elem << "\t";  
        cout << "\n";
    }   

    return 0;
}
